messages.content: What is RunRacks?
RunRacks is a hosting provider offering Linux VPS, Windows VPS and Windows Admin RDP servers on NVMe storage in 8 locations: USA, Canada, UK, Netherlands, Germany, Singapore, Australia and Japan.
What services does RunRacks offer?

We offer three products: Linux VPS (KVM, full root), Windows VPS (Server 2019/2022/2025, full Administrator) and Windows Admin RDP (ready-to-use remote desktop with full admin rights). Add-ons include extra IPs, daily backups, extra NVMe storage and cPanel licenses.
Is RunRacks a reliable hosting provider?
Yes. Every plan comes with dedicated resources, NVMe storage, DDoS protection, free weekly backups, a 99.9% uptime SLA and 24/7 support.
What makes RunRacks different from other VPS providers?

RunRacks gives you more resources for less: for example, VPS 1 has 4 vCPU, 6 GB RAM, 100 GB NVMe and 30 TB traffic on a 10 Gbps port from $4.49/month, plus free weekly backups, DDoS protection and local payment options like JazzCash and Easypaisa.
Why should I choose RunRacks over DigitalOcean or Vultr?

Compared to most big cloud providers, RunRacks gives you more vCPU, RAM and traffic for the same price, with flat monthly pricing (no surprise hourly bills), free weekly backups and local payment methods such as JazzCash and Easypaisa.
Why should I choose RunRacks over Contabo?
RunRacks focuses on NVMe storage, dedicated resources and 30 TB traffic on every plan, with fast 10-minute setup, free weekly backups and payment options that work well for customers in Pakistan.
Does RunRacks own its own hardware?
Our servers run in professional third-party data centers in each location, on hardware dedicated to RunRacks customers.
Which data centers does RunRacks use?
We use professional data centers in New York (USA), Montreal (Canada), London (UK), Amsterdam (Netherlands), Frankfurt (Germany), Singapore, Sydney (Australia) and Tokyo (Japan).
Do you use SSD or NVMe storage?
All plans use NVMe SSD storage, which is much faster than regular SSD or HDD.
Is RunRacks suitable for beginners?
Yes. Our Admin RDP is ready to use right away, and our support team can help with basic setup questions. If you're new to Linux, Windows VPS or Admin RDP is usually easier to start with.
Is RunRacks suitable for businesses?
Yes. Many businesses use RunRacks for websites, apps, trading and remote work. Plans scale up to 24 vCPU and 120 GB RAM, and you can order multiple servers under one account.
Do you offer shared hosting?
No, we don't offer shared hosting right now. We offer Linux VPS, Windows VPS and Windows Admin RDP. A VPS gives you your own dedicated resources and full control.
Do you offer dedicated servers?
Not at the moment. Our largest VPS plan (VPS 6) gives you 24 vCPU, 120 GB RAM and 600 GB NVMe, which covers most dedicated-server needs.
Do you offer domain registration?
No, we don't sell domains right now. You can buy a domain from any registrar (Namecheap, GoDaddy, etc.) and point it to your RunRacks server.
Do you offer web hosting with cPanel?
We don't offer shared cPanel hosting, but you can add a cPanel license to any Linux VPS for $18/month and host your sites with cPanel/WHM.
Do you offer game server hosting?
Not at the moment. We don't offer game server hosting right now.
Do you offer GPU servers?
Not at the moment. Our plans are CPU-based; GPU servers are not available yet.
Do you offer managed VPS?

Our VPS plans are unmanaged (self-managed): you get full root/admin control. Our 24/7 support helps with server, network and access issues, but software setup and configuration inside the server is your responsibility.
What is the difference between managed and unmanaged VPS?
Managed VPS means the provider sets up, updates and maintains the software for you. Unmanaged VPS means you get full control and manage the software yourself. RunRacks VPS plans are unmanaged.
Are your VPS servers managed or unmanaged?

Our VPS servers are unmanaged. You have full root/admin access and manage your own software; we take care of the hardware, network and virtualization layer and help 24/7 with access or server problems.
What is your uptime guarantee?
We offer a 99.9% uptime SLA on all plans.
What happens if uptime falls below the SLA?
If uptime falls below 99.9% in a month due to our infrastructure, you can request SLA credit by opening a ticket. Credit is given as a percentage of the monthly fee, based on the downtime.
Do you have a status page?
Yes. Check our status page for live updates.
Do you have a Trustpilot page?
Yes. You can read and leave reviews on our Trustpilot page.
What are your business hours?
Support is available 24/7 through tickets. Sales and billing questions are answered 10 AM – 10 PM PKT.
Is your website secure to buy from?
Yes. Our website uses HTTPS encryption, and card payments are processed by secure payment gateways. We never store your full card number.
Do you have a mobile app?
We don't have a mobile app yet, but our website and client area work well on mobile browsers.
Do you have an API for managing services?
Not at the moment. You can manage your servers (start, stop, reboot, reinstall) from the client area.
Which plan is best for me?

Tell us what you want to run (website, trading, bots, remote work) and we'll suggest a plan. As a quick guide: VPS 1 or 2 for small projects, VPS 3 (most popular) for busy sites and apps, and Admin RDP for forex and remote desktop work.
Which VPS plan should I choose for a WordPress website?
VPS 1 (4 vCPU, 6 GB RAM, 100 GB NVMe, $4.49/month) is enough for one or several small WordPress sites. For a busy site or WooCommerce, choose VPS 2 or VPS 3.
Which plan is best for a small business website?
VPS 1 or VPS 2 is ideal for a small business website. They give plenty of RAM and NVMe speed for a fast site with room to grow.
Which plan is good for an online store?
For an online store (WooCommerce, Magento, etc.) we recommend VPS 2 (8 GB RAM) for a new store and VPS 3 (24 GB RAM) for a busy store with many products.
Which plan is best for forex trading?

For forex we recommend Windows Admin RDP. RDP Starter (2 vCPU, 4 GB) runs 2–3 MT4/MT5 terminals; RDP Pro (4 vCPU, 8 GB, most popular) is better for several terminals and EAs. Choose the location closest to your broker's server.
Which plan is good for running trading bots?
For trading bots, a Linux VPS 1 or VPS 2 works well for Python or Node.js bots. For Windows-based bots or MT4/MT5, choose Admin RDP Pro or a Windows VPS.
Which plan is best for a Minecraft server?
We don't offer game server hosting at the moment.
Which plan is best for running a VPN?
VPS 1 is more than enough for a personal or family VPN (WireGuard or OpenVPN), with 30 TB traffic and a 10 Gbps port.
Which plan should I choose for a Node.js app?
VPS 1 or VPS 2 is perfect for most Node.js apps. Choose VPS 3 if your app has many users or needs more RAM.
Which plan is good for a Laravel or PHP application?
VPS 1 or VPS 2 works well for a Laravel/PHP application. Upgrade to VPS 3 as traffic grows.
Which plan is best for a Python or Django app?
VPS 1 or VPS 2 is a good fit for most Python/Django apps. Pick VPS 3 for heavier workloads.
Which plan is best for Docker containers?
VPS 2 (4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM) is a good start for Docker. For many containers, VPS 3 (8 vCPU, 24 GB) gives plenty of headroom.
How much RAM do I need for my website?
A small website needs 1–2 GB RAM, so even VPS 1 (6 GB) is generous. Busy WooCommerce or multiple sites do best with 8 GB or more.
How many CPU cores do I need?
Most websites and bots need 2–4 cores. All our VPS plans start at 4 vCPU, so even VPS 1 has plenty for most projects.
How much storage do I need?
Most websites need under 20 GB. VPS 1 includes 100 GB NVMe, and you can add 100 GB more for $5/month if needed.
What plan do I need for 10,000 visitors per month?
VPS 1 can easily handle 10,000 visitors per month for a normal website.
What plan do I need for 100,000 visitors per month?
For 100,000 visitors per month, VPS 2 is usually enough; choose VPS 3 if your site is dynamic (WooCommerce, forums) or uses heavy plugins.
Should I choose Linux VPS or Windows VPS?
Choose Linux VPS for websites, apps, bots and Docker (cheaper and lighter). Choose Windows VPS if you need Windows software, MT4/MT5, .NET or a desktop you can use with Remote Desktop.
Should I choose a VPS or an RDP?
Choose a VPS if you want a full server with OS choice. Choose Admin RDP if you want a ready-to-use Windows desktop for trading, browsing, bots or remote work.
What is the difference between VPS and RDP?

A VPS is a full virtual server where you choose the OS and set everything up. Our Admin RDP is a ready-to-use Windows Remote Desktop with full admin rights, prepared for trading, remote work and automation.
What is the difference between Windows VPS and RDP?

Both give full admin rights on Windows. Windows VPS uses our VPS hardware tiers (from 4 vCPU) and lets you choose Server 2019/2022/2025. Admin RDP plans are ready-made Windows desktops for trading and remote work, starting smaller and cheaper.
Can I start with a small plan and upgrade later?
Yes. You can start small and upgrade anytime from the client area without losing your data.
Which location should I choose?
Pick the location closest to your users (for websites) or your broker (for trading). From Pakistan, Singapore and the Netherlands/Germany usually give the best speed.
Which location is best for customers in Pakistan?
For users in Pakistan, Singapore gives the lowest ping in Asia, while Frankfurt (Germany) and Amsterdam (Netherlands) also give good, stable speed.
Which location is best for customers in the Middle East?
For the Middle East, Frankfurt (Germany) or Amsterdam (Netherlands) usually give the best results among our locations.
Which location is best for customers in Europe?
For Europe, choose Frankfurt (Germany), Amsterdam (Netherlands) or London (UK).
Which location is best for customers in the USA?
For the USA, choose New York. For Canada, choose Montreal.
Which location is best for customers in India?
For India, Singapore gives the lowest ping.
Which location gives the lowest ping from Asia?
Singapore gives the lowest ping for most of Asia, and Tokyo is best for East Asia.
Can you recommend a plan if I tell you my requirements?
Yes! Tell us what you'll run, how many users or terminals, and your budget, and we'll recommend the right plan.
Do you offer custom plans?
Not at the moment, but our 6 VPS plans and 4 RDP plans cover a wide range, and you can add extra storage and IPs. For special needs, contact sales.
Can I get more RAM without upgrading the whole plan?
You can add extra NVMe storage and IPs as add-ons. To get more RAM, upgrade to the next plan.
Can I get extra storage only?
Yes. You can add 100 GB extra NVMe storage for $5/month.
Do you have a free trial?
We don't offer a free trial at the moment. Start with a monthly plan.
Do you have a demo server I can test?
We don't offer a free trial at the moment. Start with a monthly plan.
Do you offer a money-back guarantee?
No. We don't offer refunds or a money-back guarantee, so we recommend starting with a monthly plan and upgrading when you're sure.
Can I buy multiple servers at once?
Yes. You can order multiple servers in one checkout.
Do you offer bulk or volume discounts?
Longer billing cycles get discounts: 5% quarterly, 10% semi-annual and 15% annual. For 10+ servers, contact sales about volume pricing.
What is a Linux VPS?
A Linux VPS is a virtual private server running Linux, with its own dedicated CPU, RAM, storage and IP. You get full root access to install anything you need.
Which Linux distributions do you offer?
We offer Ubuntu 24.04, Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12, AlmaLinux 9, Rocky Linux 9 and CentOS Stream 9.
Do you offer Ubuntu?
Yes. Ubuntu 24.04 and 22.04 are available.
Which Ubuntu versions are available?
Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 22.04 LTS.
Do you offer Debian?
Yes. Debian 12 is available.
Do you offer AlmaLinux?
Yes. AlmaLinux 9 is available.
Do you offer Rocky Linux?
Yes. Rocky Linux 9 is available.
Do you offer CentOS?
We offer CentOS Stream 9. For a CentOS-like stable system, AlmaLinux 9 or Rocky Linux 9 are recommended.
Do you offer Fedora?
Fedora is not in our standard templates. Open a ticket and we'll check if we can mount a custom ISO for you.
Do you offer Arch Linux?
Arch Linux is not in our standard templates. Open a ticket to request a custom ISO.
Can I install a custom Linux ISO?
Custom ISOs can be requested through a support ticket.
Do I get full root access on Linux VPS?
Yes. Every Linux VPS comes with full root access.
What virtualization do you use, KVM or OpenVZ?
We use KVM virtualization, which gives you a real dedicated virtual machine with your own kernel.
Is the Linux VPS KVM-based?
Yes. All Linux VPS are KVM-based.
Can I run Docker on your Linux VPS?
Yes. Docker works fully on our KVM VPS.
Can I run Kubernetes on your VPS?
Yes. You can run Kubernetes (k3s, k8s, microk8s) on one or more VPS.
Can I install my own kernel?
Yes. Because we use KVM, you can install and boot your own kernel.
Can I install a desktop environment (GUI) on Linux VPS?
Yes. You can install a desktop like XFCE and connect with XRDP or VNC. We recommend at least VPS 2 for a smooth desktop.
Can I install cPanel on Linux VPS?
Yes. You can install cPanel on AlmaLinux or Rocky Linux, and we sell cPanel licenses for $18/month.
Can I install Plesk on Linux VPS?
Yes. You can install Plesk on Ubuntu, Debian or AlmaLinux. You'll need your own Plesk license.
Can I install CyberPanel or aaPanel?
Yes. CyberPanel and aaPanel can be installed for free on your VPS.
Can I install Webmin or Virtualmin?
Yes. Webmin and Virtualmin can be installed for free.
Can I install HestiaCP or CloudPanel?
Yes. HestiaCP and CloudPanel are free and work well on our VPS.
Can I install OpenVPN or WireGuard?
Yes. You can run OpenVPN or WireGuard for personal or business use.
Can I host multiple websites on one Linux VPS?
Yes. You can host as many websites as your plan's resources allow.
Can I run a mail server on Linux VPS?
Yes. Port 25 is blocked by default to prevent spam; open a ticket to request it be opened for a legitimate mail server.
Can I run a database server like MySQL or PostgreSQL?
Yes. You can run MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL.
Can I run MongoDB or Redis?
Yes. MongoDB and Redis work fine. Make sure you set a password and don't expose them openly to the internet.
Can I run a Node.js app 24/7?
Yes. Your VPS runs 24/7. Use PM2 or systemd to keep your Node.js app running and restart it automatically.
Can I run a Python bot 24/7?
Yes. Use systemd, screen or PM2 to keep your Python bot running 24/7.
Can I run a Telegram or Discord bot?
Yes. Telegram and Discord bots run perfectly on a Linux VPS.
Is swap enabled on Linux VPS?
Swap is not enabled by default on most templates. You can create a swap file yourself in a few commands.
How much RAM is guaranteed on Linux VPS?
All RAM is dedicated and fully guaranteed. VPS 1 has 6 GB, up to 120 GB on VPS 6.
Are CPU cores dedicated or shared?
Resources on all our plans are dedicated, so the vCPUs in your plan are reserved for you.
What port speed does the Linux VPS have?
All VPS plans are connected to a 10 Gbps port.
Is IPv6 included with Linux VPS?
Yes. Every VPS includes 1 IPv4 and IPv6.
How do I connect to my Linux VPS?
Connect with SSH using your server IP, the username root and the password from your welcome email. On Windows use PuTTY or Windows Terminal; on Mac/Linux use the terminal: ssh root@your-ip.
What is the default SSH port?
The default SSH port is 22.
Can I change the SSH port?
Yes. Edit /etc/ssh/sshd_config, change the Port line, allow the new port in your firewall, and restart SSH.
Can I use SSH keys instead of a password?
Yes. We recommend SSH keys. Add your public key to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys and then you can disable password login.
How do I reset my root password?
You can reset your root password from the client area, or use the VNC console. If you're stuck, open a ticket.
Do you provide a VNC or console access?
Yes. Every VPS has VNC/web console access from the client area, even if SSH is not working.
Can I mount an ISO on my Linux VPS?
Custom ISOs can be mounted on request; open a support ticket.
Is the Linux VPS suitable for production use?
Yes. Our Linux VPS run on NVMe and KVM with a 99.9% uptime SLA and are suitable for production use.
Do you pre-install any software on Linux VPS?
No. You get a clean OS install so you can set it up exactly the way you want.
Do Linux VPS come with a firewall enabled?
Our templates come with a clean OS. We recommend enabling UFW or firewalld after your first login.
Can I set up a LAMP or LEMP stack?
Yes. You can install Apache or Nginx with MySQL/MariaDB and PHP in a few minutes.
Do you provide one-click app installs on Linux?
Not at the moment. You get a clean OS; you can install tools like CyberPanel or HestiaCP to get one-click apps.
What is a Windows VPS?
A Windows VPS is a virtual server running Windows Server with full Administrator access. You connect with Remote Desktop and use it like your own Windows computer that runs 24/7.
Which Windows versions do you offer?
We offer Windows Server 2025, 2022 and 2019.
Do you offer Windows Server 2019?
Yes. Windows Server 2019 is available.
Do you offer Windows Server 2022?
Yes. Windows Server 2022 is available.
Do you offer Windows Server 2025?
Yes. Windows Server 2025 is available.
Do you offer Windows 10 or Windows 11 VPS?
No. We offer Windows Server 2019, 2022 and 2025. They look and work like Windows 10/11 for most software.
Is the Windows license included in the price?
The Windows license costs $12/month and is added to the Linux plan price. For example, VPS 1 with Windows is $4.49 + $12 = $16.49/month.
Is Windows activated on the VPS?
Yes. Windows comes licensed and activated.
Do I get administrator access on Windows VPS?
Yes. You get full Administrator access.
How do I connect to my Windows VPS?
Use Remote Desktop (mstsc on Windows, Microsoft Remote Desktop on Mac or mobile). Enter your server IP, the username Administrator and the password from your welcome email.
What is the default RDP port?
The default RDP port is 3389.
Can I change the RDP port?
Yes. You can change it in the registry and allow the new port in Windows Firewall. Allow the new port first, or you may lock yourself out.
How many users can log in to Windows VPS at once?
Windows Server allows 2 simultaneous admin sessions by default. More users need RDS CALs.
Do you provide RDS/RDP CALs for multiple users?
Not at the moment. Windows Server allows 2 users at the same time.
Can I install any software on Windows VPS?
Yes. You have full admin rights, so you can install any legal software.
Can I run MetaTrader 4 or MetaTrader 5 on Windows VPS?
Yes. MT4 and MT5 run perfectly on our Windows VPS.
Can I run multiple MT4/MT5 terminals?
Yes. You can run multiple terminals; the number depends on your RAM. As a guide, 8 GB RAM runs around 6–10 terminals.
Can I install Microsoft Office on Windows VPS?
Yes, but Microsoft Office needs its own license.
Can I run SQL Server on Windows VPS?
Yes. SQL Server Express is free; other editions need your own license.
Can I host ASP.NET websites on Windows VPS?
Yes. You can install IIS and host ASP.NET and .NET Core sites.
Can I install IIS?
Yes. IIS can be enabled from Server Manager.
Can I run Google Chrome or browsers on Windows VPS?
Yes. You can install Chrome, Firefox or Edge.
Can I use Windows VPS for browsing and downloading?
Yes. You can browse and download freely, as long as it's legal and follows our Acceptable Use Policy.
Can I run a game server on Windows VPS?
We don't offer game server hosting at the moment.
Can I install antivirus on Windows VPS?
Yes. You can install any antivirus you prefer.
Does Windows VPS have Windows Defender enabled?
Yes. Windows Defender is enabled by default.
Is Windows Update enabled?
Yes. Windows Update is enabled by default to keep your server secure.
Can I disable Windows Update?
Yes, you can pause or configure Windows Update, but we recommend installing security updates regularly.
Which language is Windows installed in?
Windows is installed in English by default.
Can I change Windows language to another language?
Yes. You can add another display language from Settings > Time & Language.
Can I change the time zone on Windows VPS?
Yes. Go to Settings > Time & Language and choose your time zone.
How much disk space does Windows itself use?
Windows Server typically uses around 15–25 GB of disk space.
Why is Windows VPS more expensive than Linux VPS?
Windows needs a Microsoft license ($12/month) and uses more resources than Linux.
Can I bring my own Windows license?
Not on our standard plans. Windows is provided with our license.
Can I install Windows from my own ISO?
Custom ISOs can be requested through a support ticket.
How long does Windows VPS setup take?
Windows VPS setup usually takes about 10 minutes after your payment is confirmed.
Can I connect to Windows VPS from a Mac?
Yes. Use the Microsoft Remote Desktop (Windows App) from the Mac App Store.
Can I connect to Windows VPS from Android or iPhone?
Yes. Use the Microsoft Remote Desktop (Windows App) on Android or iPhone.
Is audio supported over RDP?
Yes. Enable "Play on this computer" in your RDP client's Local Resources settings.
Can I copy and paste files between my PC and Windows VPS?
Yes. Copy and paste of text and files works when clipboard sharing is enabled in your RDP client.
Can I transfer files to Windows VPS by drag and drop?
Yes, with most RDP clients you can drag and drop or copy-paste files. For large files, use cloud storage or file sharing.
Can I map my local drive over RDP?
Yes. In your RDP client, go to Local Resources > More and select the drives you want to share.
Does Windows VPS support GPU acceleration?
No. Our plans don't include GPUs.
Is Windows VPS good for automation software?
Yes. Windows VPS is great for automation software, bots and scheduled tasks that run 24/7.
Can I run Selenium or Puppeteer bots on Windows VPS?
Yes. Selenium, Puppeteer and Playwright run well on Windows VPS.
What is RDP?

RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) lets you connect to a Windows computer over the internet and use it as if you were sitting in front of it. Our Admin RDP is a Windows server you control from your PC or phone.
What is the difference between your RDP and Windows VPS?

Admin RDP is a ready-to-use Windows Remote Desktop for trading, remote work and automation, with smaller, cheaper plans from $11.99/month. Windows VPS uses our larger VPS hardware tiers and lets you choose the Windows Server version.
Is your RDP shared or private?
Our RDP is private. Every Admin RDP is your own Windows server with dedicated resources, not shared with other users.
Do I get admin access on RDP?
Yes. Every RunRacks RDP comes with full administrator rights.
Which Windows version is used for RDP?
Admin RDP comes with Windows Server (Windows Server 2022).
Can I install software on RDP?
Yes. You have full admin rights, so you can install any legal software.
How do I log in to my RDP?
Open Remote Desktop on your device, enter the IP from your welcome email, and log in with the username and password provided.
Which app should I use to connect to RDP?
On Windows, use the built-in Remote Desktop Connection (mstsc). On Mac, Android and iPhone, use Microsoft Remote Desktop (Windows App).
How do I use RDP on Windows?
Press Windows + R, type mstsc and press Enter. Enter your RDP IP, click Connect, then enter your username and password.
How do I use RDP on Mac?
Install Microsoft Remote Desktop (Windows App) from the Mac App Store, add a PC with your IP, and log in with your username and password.
How do I use RDP on mobile?
Install Microsoft Remote Desktop (Windows App) from the Play Store or App Store, add your RDP IP, and log in with your username and password.
Can I use RDP for downloading?
Yes. Downloading legal files is fine, and you get fast speeds with 30 TB of monthly traffic.
Can I use RDP for torrenting?
No. Torrenting is not allowed on RunRacks servers because it often leads to copyright complaints.
Can I use RDP for YouTube or streaming?
Yes, streaming and watching YouTube works, though without a GPU very high-resolution video may not be perfectly smooth over RDP.
Can I use RDP for forex trading?
Yes. Forex trading is one of the main uses of our Admin RDP. MT4/MT5 and EAs run 24/7.
Can I use RDP for social media management?
Yes. You can manage your social media accounts from your RDP, as long as you don't run spam or fake engagement bots.
Can I use RDP for running multiple browsers?
Yes. You can run multiple browsers and browser profiles; the number depends on your plan's RAM.
Can I use RDP for gaming?
RDP isn't designed for gaming because there's no GPU and streaming adds delay.
Can I use RDP for crypto mining?
No. Crypto mining is not allowed on any RunRacks server.
Can I use RDP for email sending?
Normal email from apps is fine, but bulk email or spam is not allowed. SMTP port 25 is blocked by default.
Can I use RDP for web scraping?
Yes, web scraping is allowed as long as it's legal and doesn't harm the target websites.
Can I use RDP for freelancing work?
Yes. Admin RDP is great for freelancers who need a stable Windows computer and a fixed IP in another country.
Is RDP good for Upwork or Fiverr?
Yes. Many freelancers use our RDP for Upwork and Fiverr work. Follow each platform's rules about access and location.
Will my RDP IP be dedicated?
Yes. Each Admin RDP has its own dedicated IPv4 address.
Can I choose the RDP country?
Yes. Choose from USA, Canada, UK, Netherlands, Germany, Singapore, Australia or Japan at checkout.
What is the internet speed on RDP?
RDP runs on a 10 Gbps port, so downloads and browsing are very fast.
Is there a bandwidth limit on RDP?
Admin RDP includes 30 TB of traffic per month.
Is RDP available 24/7?
Yes. Your RDP runs 24/7 with a 99.9% uptime SLA.
Will my RDP stay on when I disconnect?
Yes. Your RDP keeps running when you disconnect. Only "Shut down" or "Restart" turns it off.
Do programs keep running after I close RDP?
Yes, if you click Disconnect (the X button). If you choose "Sign out", your programs will close.
How many RDP sessions can I open?
Windows allows 2 simultaneous admin sessions by default.
Can multiple people use my RDP?
Yes. You can create another Windows user, and up to 2 sessions can be active at the same time.
Can I add another user to my RDP?
Yes. Create a new user in Computer Management > Local Users and Groups and add it to the Remote Desktop Users group.
Can I change my RDP password?
Yes. Press Ctrl+Alt+End inside RDP and choose "Change a password", or change it from Computer Management.
Is RDP delivered instantly?
Yes. RDP is set up automatically and is usually ready in about 10 minutes after payment.
How long does RDP take to activate?
Usually about 10 minutes after your payment is confirmed. Manual payments (JazzCash, Easypaisa) are activated after we verify the payment.
Is RDP safe to use?
Yes, as long as you use a strong password and keep Windows updated. We also provide DDoS protection.
Can my RDP be hacked?
Any server can be hacked if the password is weak. Use a long, unique password, change the default RDP port, and keep Windows updated.
How do I secure my RDP?
Use a strong password, change the default RDP port 3389, enable Windows Firewall, keep Windows updated, and don't share your login details.
Can I get an RDP with a residential IP?
No. Our IPs are datacenter IPs, not residential IPs.
Can I get RDP with a US IP?
Yes. Choose New York (USA) at checkout.
Can I get RDP with a UK IP?
Yes. Choose London (UK) at checkout.
Is admin RDP more expensive than shared RDP?
All RunRacks RDP plans are Admin RDP. We don't sell shared RDP.
Can I upgrade my RDP to a Windows VPS?
Yes. You can move to a Windows VPS; open a ticket and we'll help you migrate.
Can I use RDP to access banking or PayPal websites?
Technically yes, but some banks and payment sites may ask for extra verification from datacenter IPs. Use it at your own risk and follow your bank's rules.
Which server locations do you offer?
We have 8 locations: New York (USA), Montreal (Canada), London (UK), Amsterdam (Netherlands), Frankfurt (Germany), Singapore, Sydney (Australia) and Tokyo (Japan).
Do you have servers in the USA?
Yes. Our US servers are in New York.
Which US city are your servers located in?
New York.
Do you have servers in the UK?
Yes. Our UK servers are in London.
Which UK city are your servers in?
London.
Do you have servers in Canada?
Yes. Our Canada servers are in Montreal.
Do you have servers in the Netherlands?
Yes. Our Netherlands servers are in Amsterdam.
Do you have servers in Germany?
Yes. Our Germany servers are in Frankfurt.
Do you have servers in Singapore?
Yes. We have servers in Singapore.
Do you have servers in Australia?
Yes. Our Australia servers are in Sydney.
Do you have servers in Japan?
Yes. Our Japan servers are in Tokyo.
Do you have servers in Pakistan?
Not at the moment. For Pakistan, Singapore gives the lowest ping, with Frankfurt and Amsterdam as good options.
Do you have servers in India?
Not at the moment. For India, Singapore is the best choice.
Do you have servers in Dubai or UAE?
Not at the moment. For the UAE, Frankfurt or Amsterdam usually give the best results.
Do you have servers in France?
Not at the moment. For France, Frankfurt, Amsterdam or London are close and fast.
Do you have servers in Hong Kong?
Not at the moment. For Hong Kong, choose Singapore or Tokyo.
Do you plan to add new locations?
Yes, we plan to add more locations. Follow our announcements for updates.
Can I request a new location?

What does VPS stand for?

How does a VPS work?
A powerful physical server is split into several isolated virtual servers. Each VPS gets its own CPU, RAM, storage, IP and operating system, and works like a separate computer.

A VPS is a virtual server running on a real physical server, but it behaves like your own private machine.

What is a snapshot?
